                                if k not in ("problem", "solution", "reference_solution", "answer")})
    print("Example problem:", rows[0]["problem"][:280])
print("MATH strata:", collections.Counter(
    (str(r.get("subject")), str(r.get("level"))) for r in datasets["math_train"]))
